reuse.why: Extends the existing getScheduleDate/getScheduleDateString weekend definition with a holidays parameter rather than writing a new mover, but the daily-skip checks re-test weekend-or-holiday inline instead of sharing a predicate.

duplication.why: The weekend-or-holiday test is written three times (local isNonWorkingDay closure in getScheduleDate, inline in getNextDate, inline in getDatesInRange).

placement.why: The holiday move lives in shared/schedules.ts with the weekend rule, but the non-working-day predicate is not exposed there, so call sites rebuild it.

scope.why: Mostly focused, with an unrelated fallback added to the solve mode in getNextDate (weekendSolve ?? weekendSolveMode).

maintainability.why: Holidays are threaded by hand per caller and the schedule-template and getDateWithSkippedWeekend callers were not given them, so the rule already differs between paths and future changes need several edits.

disguised_duplication.where: packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts getNextDate and packages/loot-core/src/server/schedules/app.ts getDatesInRange re-express getScheduleDate's isNonWorkingDay closure inline (isWeekend || holidays.includes / holidays?.includes(dayFromDate(...)))

one_place.where: The holiday test is defined in getScheduleDate's local closure and again inline in getNextDate and getDatesInRange; server/budget/schedule-template.ts calls getScheduleDateString without holidays and getDateWithSkippedWeekend does not forward them
